task: Grab the key first, then make your way to the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Existence(has_key) clause is redundant and violates compactness guidelines (Checklist #6). It is implied by the conjunction of hard Precedence(has_key, at_goal) and hard Existence(at_goal), which enforce the key being acquired before goal reachment. Remove the Existence(has_key) clause to fix redundancy.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Existence(at_goal) ensures the agent reaches the goal, and the hard Precedence(has_key, at_goal) ensures the key is acquired before reaching the goal, satisfying the task "Grab the key first, then make your way to the goal." The machine correctly rejects trajectories where the goal is reached without having held the key. No redundant clauses are present, and no environment constraints (like door_open physics) require explicit clauses beyond what the task text states.
